description: Create a new camera layout in the Nx Witness VMS desktop client. The desktop client is already open and showing the welcome screen with a 'GymAnythingVMS localhost' server tile. Click that tile to connect (credentials if prompted: admin/Admin1234!). Once connected, create a new layout named 'Security Overview'. Add all 3 available cameras ('Parking Lot Camera', 'Entrance Camera', 'Server Room Camera') to this layout. Arrange them so all cameras are visible simultaneously (e.g., in a row or grid). Save the layout when done so it persists in the system.
